basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer · Cloud Security & Policy Enforcement · Go (Golang) · Node.js · AWS · 3.5+ Years

summaries.tcs-casb-cloud-security: Backend software engineer with 3.5+ years building microservices in Go (Golang) and Node.js across AWS, with hands-on experience in cloud security policy enforcement, compliance automation, and CI/CD. Built a Kafka-based policy-enforcement pipeline and 1,000+ multi-cloud compliance checks across CIS, NIST, HIPAA, and PCI DSS frameworks for Turbot HQ, cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
work.domainNote: Multi-cloud security, governance, and compliance software; makers of the open-source Steampipe / Powerpipe / Flowpipe / Tailpipe suite and the commercial Turbot Guardrails PSPM platform. Remote-first.
highlights: Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, a cloud security policy-enforcement platform, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a cloud resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for investigation.

Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS, Azure, GCP, Microsoft 365, GitHub), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks — used by enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government for cloud data visibility and compliance — cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability/SIEM CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go (Golang) using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and resource-cleanup workflows; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating and resolved recurring AWS API throttling issues.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — unified GitHub Actions CI/CD release workflows with automated quality gates and multi-distro Linux smoke tests, hardening release safety before deployment.

projects.name: CIS Benchmark → Compliance Dashboard Generator
projects.description: Python CLI that automates compliance-dashboard authoring for a multi-cloud governance product. Ingests CIS benchmark XLSX workbooks (AWS, Azure) and emits ready-to-deploy HCL dashboard config plus markdown docs for cloud security visibility. OOP resource model, custom HCL pretty-printer, openpyxl + pandas, distributed as a pip-installable package.
